findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body: When given another tenant’s document ID, `getDocument` now drops `ctx.tenantId` and `loadDocument` queries only by `{ documentId }`. In a shared database, this removes the existing tenant boundary and can disclose another tenant’s document.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
In a shared database, requests now query only by `documentId` and ignore `ctx.tenantId`. A caller supplying an ID belonging to another tenant can receive that tenant’s document, causing cross-tenant data disclosure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache module
findings.body:
Removing `src/cache.ts` also removes the existing `readCached` export. Any consumer or test importing this established module will fail compilation/module resolution instead of parsing cached payloads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
An authenticated tenant can supply another tenant’s document ID and retrieve it because `ctx.tenantId` is no longer included in the database query. This creates a cross-tenant IDOR whenever document IDs are known or guessable.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
